Name: Advanced_Copper_Tools
Author: Jared
Description: Adds copper-and-bronze metalworking content: metal sheets and nails, a small copper stove, wearable metal pan (multi-metal), large copper saw with bonus tree-cutting, wheelbarrow with weight reduction, copper bathtub (3 states, with a Hot Bath tier for keeping the fire stoked, and a Wash with Soap interaction for a bigger cleansing and mood boost), 4-variant metal lantern with rendered oil (from animal fat, fatty fish meat, or hemp seed oil with H&F installed), copper oil flask, copper tea kettle, copper cauldron for batch cooking and brewing, sealed copper chest, a high-capacity Ore Chest for bulk mining raws, a 3-variant Tea Blending Station with six herb slots, passive drying, a Grind All action, a built-in heated water reservoir, and three brewable herbal teas (Calming, Warming, Focus). Includes copper, bronze, and iron armor tiers — helmet, bracers, greaves, and torso armor, all furnace-recyclable. The oil flask, cauldron, and armor track the metal they were built from (copper through white bronze). Also adds a copper watering can, a copper-rim chamberpot, and Salt-Cured Meat, a slow-spoiling ration made from raw meat and salt. Adds a branching cave system east of Waterfall Caves: Copper Vein Cave (north), Tin Vein Cave (east), and Iron Vein Cave (south) — each with a minable ore vein — plus a Salt Mine east of the Copper Vein Cave and a Rock Quarry east of the Tin Vein Cave, connected to each other north-south, each with its own minable vein and Collapsed Rock Face passage.
